title: Feed twice a day
vo: From now on, feed it twice a day, 12 hours apart, at about 9 in the morning and 9 at night. Each time, keep 50 grams and discard the rest. Add 50 grams of strong white flour and 50 grams of water, stir, and mark the level.
voUS: From now on, feed it twice a day, 12 hours apart, at about 9 in the morning and 9 at night. Each time, keep three and a half tablespoons and discard the rest. Add a third of a cup plus a tablespoon of bread flour and three and a half tablespoons of water, stir, and mark the level.
cap: Feed twice a day, 12 hours apart: about 9 am and 9 pm.
Each time keep 50 g, then add 50 g strong white flour and 50 g water.
capUS: Feed twice a day, 12 hours apart: about 9 am and 9 pm.
Each time keep 3½ tbsp, then add ⅓ cup + 1 tbsp bread flour and 3½ tbsp water.
